name: PharmaQuest
summary: Gamified practice for the pharmacist qualifying exam, built for a pharmacist preparing for it
tldr: I designed and built PharmaQuest for a pharmacist preparing for the PEBC exam: 257 practice questions with every option explained, spaced repetition, and a game layer that rewards showing up. It's live, with progress saved to the cloud.

caseStudy.tools: React, Vite, Cloudflare Pages and D1
caseStudy.result: Live, with 257 practice questions and cloud-synced progress
